objective: Implement and test a fail-closed Databento CME 6E MBP-10 event-window acquisition planner, then produce a free metadata-only cost quote and immutable source plan without downloading time-series data.

source_contract.key_source: Windows user environment DATABENTO_API_KEY; never print or persist

required_behavior: Verify every bound SHA before any API call.
Plan exactly 630 non-overlapping identities from the frozen clock CSV; overlapping time windows may remain separate identities but must be reported.
Quote every planned window with historical-streaming semantics and zero time-series calls.
Persist deterministic plan_id excluding generated timestamps.
Record per-window billable bytes and estimated USD, total estimate, SDK version, API method counters and paid_request_made=false.

Implement a future download command only if it requires both expected plan_id and --approve-max-usd, re-quotes before the first paid call, checkpoints in_flight, downloads serially, never auto-retries a charged or empty response, validates DBN fully and writes only to the D-side root.
The current task must not invoke the future download command.
acceptance_gates: Registry validator passes before and after.
Plan contains exactly 630 event identities and matches clock SHA.
Quote receipt proves timeseries_calls=0, paid_request_made=false and covers all 630 identities.
No raw DBN file, EURUSD price outcome, PnL, MFE, MAE, PF or expectancy is created or read.
Secret scan finds no API key value in any artifact or tool output.
prohibitions: Do not edit registry, probe plan, clock CSV/manifest, docs outside the write_set, prior EA packages or AlphaFactory shared tools.
Do not create a branch, worktree or clone; do not stage, commit or push.
Do not add strategy thresholds or run an EA compile/backtest.
Do not revert or overwrite edits made by other agents or the Owner.
